BRICK_WALL × BRICKWORK is not a BNBC cell: the walls are drawn and billed in the architect's set, and the pair is F-ARCH's — its rows are read from goldenRows('arch') (GF..6F, components BW250/BW125, S-25's lintels deducted), and BNBC's golden keeps only the LINTEL rows (R0-G3, D-009). Each entry is {cell: {class, kind}, expected_residue?}: the `cell` dict is the row selector (cell ⊆ row), the residue note sits beside it (adversary 4).
